dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm looking at your sales for the past year. What happened in December?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈlʊkɪŋ ət jʊr ˈseɪlz fər ðə ˈpæst ˈjɪr. ˈwʌt ˈhæpənd ɪn dɪˈsɛmbər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sales fell sharply. Most students go home during the semester break.
dialogue.reading: ˈseɪlz ˈfɛl ˈʃɑːrpli. ˈmoʊst ˈstuːdənts ˈɡoʊ ˈhoʊm ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə səˈmɛstər ˌbreɪk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That was a dramatic fall. Did you lose a lot of money?
dialogue.reading: ðæt wʌz ə drəˈmætɪk ˈfɔːl. dɪd juː ˈluːz ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈmʌni?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A little. But sales recovered quickly when the new semester started.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. bʌt ˈseɪlz rɪˈkʌvərd ˈkwɪkli wɛn ðə ˈnuː səˈmɛstər ˈstɑːrtɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They rose steadily. There was a steady rise of about 10% a month.
dialogue.reading: ðeɪ ˈroʊz ˈstɛdəli. ðɛr wʌz ə ˈstɛdi ˈraɪz əv əˈbaʊt ˈtɛn pərˈsɛnt ə ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I can see a slight fall in April. Why was that?
dialogue.reading: aɪ kən ˈsiː ə ˈslaɪt ˈfɔːl ɪn ˈeɪprəl. ˈwaɪ wʌz ˈðæt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It was Songkran, and lots of students went home for a few days. Sales fell slightly.
dialogue.reading: ɪt wʌz ˈsɔːŋkrɑːn, ənd ˈlɑːts əv ˈstuːdənts ˈwɛnt ˈhoʊm fər ə ˈfjuː ˈdeɪz. ˈseɪlz ˈfɛl ˈslaɪtli.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: They're growing gradually. But when we started delivering to offices, they rose dramatically.
dialogue.reading: ðɛr ˈɡroʊɪŋ ˈɡrædʒuəli. bʌt wɛn wiː ˈstɑːrtɪd dɪˈlɪvərɪŋ tə ˈɔːfɪsɪz, ðeɪ ˈroʊz drəˈmætɪkli.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: By 40% in one month! We were really surprised.
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈfɔːrti pərˈsɛnt ɪn ˈwʌn ˈmʌnθ! wiː wɜːr ˈriːli sərˈpraɪzd.
